title: Longest Common Subsequence
goal: Solve Longest Common Subsequence: 2D DP: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]+1 on match, else max of dp[i-1][j] and dp[i][j-1].
strategy: 2D DP: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]+1 on match, else max of dp[i-1][j] and dp[i][j-1].
edgeCases: Empty prefixes have common-subsequence length zero. Equal characters extend the diagonal; unequal characters require choosing between dropping either suffix character.
